decision: Selected the site location that the Environment Agency's installations register publishes for permit EPR/TP3500PB (holder Equinix (UK) Limited, premises '2 Powergate Business Park', Volt Avenue, Park Royal, Ealing NW10 6PW): latitude 51.530532, longitude -0.258024 (grid reference TQ2093082730), copied without transformation, as the campus locator of Equinix LD9 ('Equinix Powergate'). It is the regulator's single site point for the installation, which spans three buildings (PG1, PG2 and HV); it is not a building outline or surveyed position.

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published latitude and longitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:27700 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's easting and northing (520930, 182730) gives 51.5305377, -0.2580312, 0.81 m from the published point.

consistency_checks.permit_decision_document: The variation decision document published at the register's documentURL (local_data/country-research-uk-ops-p10/govuk-ld9-tp3500pb-v003-decision-document.pdf, sha256 2a3faad8f6bf55e4bd435299bf89714714635728a447755dd70541e2926ab243; GOV.UK publication of 9 January 2024) grants variation EPR/TP3500PB/V003 'for Equinix Powergate operated by Equinix (UK) Limited', describes 'an existing data centre' on Powergate Business Park whose site consists of three buildings, PG1 (built 2008), PG2 (built 2012) and a new HV building then being built, and gives 'The National Grid Reference for the site is TQ 21070 82738'. pyproj 3.7.1 converts TQ 21070 82738 to 51.5305797, -0.2560112, 139.8 m east of the register point; both are regulator-published site references for the same installation, and the spread indicates the site's extent.
consistency_checks.operator_address: Equinix's LD9 page (Internet Archive raw copy of 3 October 2026, local_data/country-research-uk-ops-p10/ia-eqx-ld9-20261003180942.html) gives the address '2, Powergate Business Park, Volt Avenue, NW10 6PW London' and 165,463 sq ft; its meta description says 'Unit 2 Powergate Business, Park Volt Avenue'. Same premises and postcode as the register.
consistency_checks.nearby_records: Atlas records within 2 km: Vantage London II (LHR2) campus, 37-39 North Acton Road (0.30 km), Vantage London I (LHR1) campus, Chandos Road (0.43 km), Kao Data Park Royal, Frogmore Industrial Estate (0.45 km) and Pure DC / SEGRO Park Royal LON02 (1.16 km). Environment Agency installations nearby that are not in the Atlas: Colt Data Centre Services, Units 9-13 Volt Avenue, Powergate Business Park NW10 6PN (EPR/DP3107LF, 89 m from the register point and 123 m from the decision-document NGR; a different operator, unit and permit, listed in the thirty-fourth update's lead of EA-permitted campuses); MSFT MCIO Limited 'L0N01 Backup Generators', Bashley Road NW10 6SN (EPR/FP3528SK, 0.28 km); Vodafone PRLON2, Coronation Road (EPR/JP3024SA, 1.07 km).
consistency_checks.not_used: No commercial map, map widget, map-link coordinate, geocoder, postcode centroid, PeeringDB, OpenStreetMap, town centre or estate centroid is used. The coordinate constants in the map-widget script of Equinix's archived pages were not read for the locator.

scope_note: The point locates Equinix's Powergate installation (PG1, PG2 and HV buildings) as a whole; it may lie a hundred metres or more from a given building and is close to Colt's separate Powergate data centre.
